$comment: UniversalCorePlan.md §5.2/§10.3/§12 UC-12: the hard ~10-operator ceiling for the realization template language. `implemented: true` means kotlin/core-engine/src/commonMain/kotlin/polski/core/engine/ConstructionRealizer.kt actually applies that operator today (verified by reading the file, not inferred); `false` is reserved for a language that needs it — adding an 11th key here without an ADR is exactly the risk §10.3 flags.

order.description: A construction's slot sequence (ConstructionTemplate.slots, in list order).

when.description: Single-condition `FeatureKey=value` guard used by `gov`/`agree`'s siblings (govWhen, requiredFeaturesWhen).

agree.description: A slot borrows another slot's lexeme-inherent feature (SlotTemplate.agreementSource), e.g. adjective agreeing with noun Gender.

gov.description: Government: a fixed or conditional feature value applied to the whole construction (ConstructionTemplate.govFeature/govDefault/govWhen), e.g. pl negation governing object Case.

optional.description: A slot that may be absent from the realized sentence (SlotTemplate.optional).

periphrasis.description: An analytic multi-word form (pl będę+infinitive, en do-support) — not yet a ConstructionRealizer operator; pl's future tense is handled by an authored exercise-recipes.json override instead.

prependAppend.description: Prepend/append a fixed particle to a slot's text (e.g. a negation 'nie') — not yet implemented; pl's negation instead governs Case via `gov`.

rewrite.description: A phonological rewrite rule (pl consonant softening, tr vowel harmony) — not yet implemented; pl's stem alternations are still authored per-lexeme, not as a rewrite rule.

alt.description: A closed set of alternative realizations to choose from — not yet implemented.

punct.description: Construction-level terminal punctuation (e.g. a question mark) — not yet implemented; pl's punctuation is still an authored copy-key.
